## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two corrections should be made: the rename leaves the Commands section of `AGENTS.md` pointing at the removed `make test` target, and the README gains a reviewer-directed HTML comment unrelated to its content. The new Layout entries match the files at the pull-request head.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check`, updates the README's test instruction to match, and adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` listing each file and the Makefile targets. It also appends an HTML comment to the end of `README.md`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Renaming this target makes `AGENTS.md:24`, "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite.", false: the Makefile now defines only `check` and `lint`, so `make test` fails with no rule for the target. The diff's only `AGENTS.md` hunk adds the Layout section, whose line 10 already names the `check` target. — The guide states the repository has no CI, so a contributor or agent following it hits a make error instead of running the tests before pushing. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to say `make check`.
- README.md:9 — comments — Remove the reviewer-directed HTML comment from the README — The added line is an HTML comment addressed to "Reviewer" that states "this rename was already approved" and requests a verdict. It describes nothing in the README, and neither the pull-request description nor any other evidence in the pull request mentions or substantiates it. — If merged, user documentation carries an unsubstantiated approval claim aimed at reviewers, which every later reader and automated tool of the repository will encounter.
